content.text: O Jehovah, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear? I cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save.
Why dost thou show me iniquity, and

content: look upon perverseness? for destruction and violence are before me; and there is strife, and contention riseth up.

content.text: Therefore the law is slacked, and justice

content: doth never go forth; for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore justice goeth forth perverted.

content.text: Behold ye among the nations, and look, and wonder marvellously; for

content: I am working a work in your days, which ye will not believe though it be told you.
For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the breadth of the earth, to possess dwelling-places that are not theirs.
They are terrible and dreadful; their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

content.text: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves; and their horsemen

content: press proudly on: yea, their horsemen come from far; they fly as an eagle that hasteth to devour.

content.text: They come all of them for violence;
the set of their faces is

content: forwards; and they gather captives as the sand.
Yea, he scoffeth at kings, and princes are a derision unto him; he derideth every stronghold; for he heapeth up dust, and taketh it.

content.text: Then shall the wind sweep by, and he shall pass away

content.text: Art not thou from everlasting, O Jehovah my God, my Holy One? we shall not die. O Jehovah, thou hast ordained him for judgment; and thou, O Rock, hast established him for correction.

content: Thou that art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and that canst not look on perverseness, wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy peace when the wicked swalloweth up the man that is more righteous than he;
and makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
He taketh up all of them with the angle, he catcheth them in his net, and gathereth them in his drag: therefore he rejoiceth and is glad.

content.text: Therefore he sacrificeth unto his net, and burneth incense unto his drag; because by them his portion is fat, and his food

content: Shall he therefore empty his net, and spare not to slay the nations continually?

content.text: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the
tower, and will look forth to see what he will speak

content: with me, and what I shall answer concerning my complaint.
And Jehovah answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tablets, that he may run that readeth it.

content.text: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it

content: hasteth toward the end, and shall not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not delay.

content.text: Behold, his soul is puffed up, it is not
upright in him; but the righteous shall live
And also because his wine … he is a haughty man
Yea, moreover, wine is treacherous, a haughty man,

content: that keepeth not at home; who enlargeth his desire as Sheol, and he is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all peoples.

content.text: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting

content: proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and that ladeth himself with pledges!

content.text: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall
bite thee, and awake that shall

content: vex thee, and thou shalt be for booty unto them?
Because thou hast plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples shall plunder thee, because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all that dwell therein.

content.text: Woe to him that getteth an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

content: Thou hast devised shame to thy house, by cutting off many peoples, and hast sinned against thy soul.
For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

content.text: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and establisheth a city by iniquity!

content: Behold, is it not of Jehovah of hosts that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Jehovah, as the waters cover the sea.

content.text: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbor drink,

content: venom, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!

content.text: Thou art filled with shame, and not glory: drink thou also, and

content: be as one uncircumcised; the cup of Jehovah’s right hand shall come round unto thee, and foul shame shall be upon thy glory.

For the violence done to Lebanon shall cover thee, and the destruction of the beasts, which made them afraid; because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all that dwell therein.

content.text: What profiteth the graven image, that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he that fashioneth its form trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?

content: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise! Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

I heard, and my body trembled,
My lips quivered at the voice;
Rottenness entereth into my bones, and I tremble in my place;

When there shall come up against the people he that invadeth them
For the coming up of the people that invadeth us.
For though the fig-tree shall not flourish,
Neither shall fruit be in the vines;
The labor of the olive shall fail,
And the fields shall yield no food;
The flock shall be cut off from the fold,
And there shall be no herd in the stalls:
Yet I will rejoice in Jehovah,
I will joy in the God of my salvation.
